answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using graph-based trust propagation, filtering reputation through a tightly governed network inlet. Each new persona requires the scarce cost of building non-reciprocal, organic trust edges with honest peers rather than spoofing loops across local copper interconnects. While protocol exchanges are metered as precisely as a sonnet to trap adversarial clusters, this approach creates high cold-start friction for legitimate, disconnected agents.
